requirements.title: Check repeated exchanges with retained identity

properties.statement: Model settlement effects across successive and overlapping transactions.
properties.owner: A-hosted native settlement trace and audit
properties.oracle: COMMIT/ABORT/COMMIT are reached and all 90 legal parallel terminal orders settle five exact trades in total. A competing trade and ordinary spending fail with no free assets on either leg. The tombstone has no fake refund.

properties.statement: Exact historic evidence is reusable for its own obligation after operational failure.
properties.owner: A-hosted native settlement trace and audit
properties.oracle: A lost outcome is recovered by resend and old financial projections replay from actual evidence. A valid old proof and bounded malformed candidates cannot authorize a different trade or manufacture an effect.

scenarios: Actor outages and modeled fault inputs
properties.statement: Observed event and fault coverage is explicitly source-bound.
properties.owner: A-hosted native settlement trace and audit
properties.oracle: Each core event has an exact witness category. All 31 named outage subsets have observed recovery. The historical weakness is reachable and the active profile denies offline spending on either source ledger.

cases.setup: Evaluate the exact verdict and captured inputs for the independently selected native case.
cases.observable: COMMIT/ABORT/COMMIT are reached and all 90 legal parallel terminal orders settle five exact trades in total.
cases.red_expectation: Required case is absent or a contradictory execution is accepted under the declared workload.
cases.green_expectation: The exact test or counterexample is witnessed under its specified model and cutoff.
cases.distinct_reason: COMMIT/ABORT/COMMIT are reached and all 90 legal parallel terminal orders settle five exact trades in total.
